data.gate_detail: Designator_Cancel.DesignateThing destroys a player Blueprint or Frame with DestroyMode.Cancel, which REFUNDS a frame's contents. Aimed at this layout's own things by id, never at their cells: the cell form would also remove every cancelable designation there, which nobody asked for.

channel.note: one single-char ASCII glyph per cell over the collapsed priority FOG > pawns > designations > things > zones > roof > terrain, with "?@$!&^;" reserved for pawns and fog; this is NOT map-dump's per-layer def-catalog alphabet and the two are not comparable cell-for-cell
